description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing River Kelpie.
When River Kelpie dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hardened Academic and River Kelpie trigger.
Resolve the Hardened Academic trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on River Kelpie.
Resolve the River Kelpie trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.
